author: Malohu
quote: Pile of sweaty garbage. The DMZ should have been PVE. The sweat hogs have already ruined it. They spawn in go directly to the extract zones and camp them. Could have been a fun game.

author: Malohu
quote: The game really is lazy trash.  I have had fun with the multiplayer but that could have just been a small expansion pack with a couple new guns and maps on the last one. The campaign is one of the worst I have ever played. I have finished all of the COD campaigns back to the beginning and tried to do this one but it is just so terrible I cant force myself to finish it. The new end game mode is stupid also. Whoever thought making the enemies into bullet sponges that take a full load of ammo to drop should never work on a game again.

author: Malohu
quote: Total waste of money. There is no story to speak of and they explain very little. Its like the whole thing was written by an elementary school drama class. The new characters are trash and the dialog is hard to listen to. No changes in the weapons just a bunch of reskins. Definitely not worth $50 let alone $99 with the season pass. If you already play Destiny you might be stuck but if your new I would skip it.

author: Malohu
quote: Bad release as usual for Activision Blizzard. Haven't been able to log in for two days. This crap gets old when it is every release no exceptions.
